title: Ashford Mill
briefing: The wheels of Ashford Mill turn to a darker grind. Four power nodes ring the millpond, and the witch's golems stalk the wheat. Hold the nodes and silence her work at the mill.
victoryText: Ashford's wheels turn honest grain again. The mill is freed.
defeatText: Ashford Mill grinds on for her alone. Its nodes are hers.
